name: On-premises data gateway
short_description: The on-premises data gateway (often called the Power BI gateway) is a Windows application installed inside a private network that carries data between on-premises sources and Microsoft cloud services such as Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, using outbound connections only. It runs in standard or personal mode.

evidence.quote: That connection runs through a power BI gateway, a small app that carries data between a private network
